state.purpose: Adversarial source review; potential failures, not release approval. Report only supplied code facts.
state.contracts: Reactors do not support projection rebuilds. Recovery plans are immutable and stale work should invalidate. FitzKV repositories own their model keys; conformance requires rebuilt model data not corrupt the live generation. An unsafe documented repository example is distinct from an unconditional adapter guarantee.

manual_reactor_ignores_rebuild_id.instructions: Does public manual ReactorRunner.RunPassAsync accept a nonblank RebuildId but use the live CheckpointIdentity, while hosted workload registration rejects that same option for reactors?

resolved_block_leaves_sibling_repairs_qu.instructions: If two plans for one block are both approved and queued, can successful completion of the first clear Block while leaving the second queued, with PrepareAsync returning early before invalidating it?

sibling_queued_repair_pins_retention.instructions: Can an obsolete repair left with status queued keep its plan retained after the underlying block is resolved?

documented_rebuild_updates_live_keys.instructions: With the documented unversioned balance key, can replay under a distinct RebuildId write the same live model rows because only checkpoint keys include the generation?

base_guarantees_generation_data_isolatio.instructions: Does the supplied FitzKvProjectionStore base itself enforce model-key isolation by RebuildId, independent of repository key design?
